name: ZQUAS
tagline: Criminals use many banks. Now banks can act as one.
description: ZQUAS lets banks catch scam payments and mule accounts together, without pooling customer data. Built on a GPU governance engine that applies an institution's rules to decisions made by automated systems and AI agents. Alerts carry proofs a supervisor can verify.
stage: TRL 6, synthetic data only, no production deployments, pre-revenue

founder.name: Danny de Gier
founder.title: Founder & Engineer
founder.qualification: Professional Postgraduate Diploma in Financial Crime Compliance (ICA / University of Manchester)

benchmark.data: Synthetic fixtures. Internal tests, not an external audit.

detection_500k.scope: 500K entities under 2 seconds on the fixed synthetic fixture, with about 55K transactions. This is a detection test, not the full product cycle.

alert_lifecycle.scope: Alert lifecycle under 10 ms per alert, from a detection result to a persisted, queryable alert. Batch results are amortised per alert.

federation_bilateral.scope: Federation bilateral round under 10 seconds on TCP loopback development transport. Semi-honest security. This does not measure a real inter-bank network.

detection_pass_vram.scope: VRAM under 1 GB in the measured detection-pass working set after warm-up. Resident ingestion and model inference are excluded. This is not total-system memory.
detection_pass_vram.regression_gate: 1 GiB. The recorded working set is below 1 GB. The gate is not a total-application memory cap.

benchmark.qualification: These scopes apply separately. They are not a full product performance guarantee.

federation.protocol: ECDH-PSI (X25519) + Yao's Garbled Circuits (Free-XOR) + IKNP OT Extension (Chou-Orlandi base OT on P-256)
federation.transport_note: Federation bilateral round under 10 seconds on TCP loopback development transport. Semi-honest security. This does not measure a real inter-bank network.
federation.raw_data_shared: no raw or directly identifying customer data leaves the institution
federation.sharing: No customer records leave your infrastructure. With network sharing switched on, the bank sends only bounded answers about payments it is part of, each one authorized by its own policy and recorded in its signed log.

proofs.statement: Every decision is signed, and the supervisor can verify it with a published check (synthetic data, development keys)
proofs.scope: Synthetic data, development keys. Internal tests, including run R43.0 B. This is verification of the signed record, not an external audit or proof that a transaction is criminal.

testing.test_count_note: No clean cross-platform figure exists. Unlike-platform counts are not added together.

capabilities.cross_institutional_detection: correspondent banking wire stripping validated end to end as a named cohort on synthetic data across simulated participants; trade-based over-invoicing, shell company layering and funnel account structuring designed and in scope, not validated

regulatory_engagement.fca_digital_sandbox: ZQUAS was accepted into the FCA's Digital Sandbox in March 2026. The FCA does not endorse ZQUAS, its products or its results.
regulatory_engagement.fca_supercharged_sandbox: ZQUAS is taking part in the FCA's Supercharged Sandbox. The FCA does not endorse ZQUAS, its products or its results.

differentiators: Privacy-preserving cross-institutional detection via MPC (semi-honest security model)
Cryptographic proof bundles for every compliance decision (Ed25519 signed, Merkle-included)

Independent regulator verification: public key plus proof bundle, without relying on the running production engine or its internal state. The verifier is vendor-written and currently links the CUDA runtime; a CPU-only verifier is planned
Constitutional governance: agents cannot file SARs autonomously
Adversarial self-testing framework with continuous mutation testing
Approximately 753,000 source lines excluding third-party code

business_model.pricing: annual licensing by transaction volume and policy complexity
business_model.expansion: cross-institutional MPC network with network effects
business_model.data_sovereignty: No customer records leave your infrastructure. With network sharing switched on, the bank sends only bounded answers about payments it is part of, each one authorized by its own policy and recorded in its signed log.

sandbox_results_synthetic.label: Synthetic data. In our model or in our test. Not real-world detection rates.
sandbox_results_synthetic.world: 1,000,000 adults at the UK scam rate
sandbox_results_synthetic.with_network_reviewed: about 1 in 2 in our model; about 1 in 3 with the generator's easiest clue removed
sandbox_results_synthetic.limits: at most 1 payment in 1,000 held and 1 in 500 reviewed; network signals add reviews, never automatic holds
sandbox_results_synthetic.scale_and_speed: up to 540 simulated bank installations on nine cloud GPUs in one cloud zone; 99 in 100 decisions in under 10 ms, in our test

pilot.duration: 12 weeks locally, starting after scope, agreements, access and data readiness are confirmed
pilot.optional_phase: Network phase afterwards by separate agreement
measures: At most 1 review per 500 payments and 1 hold per 1,000
Every decision verifiable in the signed log
pilot.scope: Scam review and local transaction monitoring on the institution's own data and infrastructure. Local transaction monitoring selects investigation work and does not itself hold payments. These are evaluation measures and limits, not promised detection rates.
pilot.offer: 12-week local pilot for scam review and local transaction monitoring

local_monitor.status: Built. Full-world evaluation not yet measured. No detection rates or alert counts published.
local_monitor.walkthrough: Synthetic example at every step: several payers in; money out within a day; funnel or rapid pass-through pattern score; analyst queue within a daily analyst-time limit and monthly investigation allowance; tm-alert in the signed decision log; the bank decides.

exchange_withdrawal_test.statement: Exchanges as members: we are testing a withdrawal check that asks the funding bank one question about the payment that funded it. Results will be published when the test is complete.
